title: Array Transformation
summary: Starting from arr, form each new day's array simultaneously from the preceding day's values.
statement: Starting from arr, form each new day's array simultaneously from the preceding day's values. Keep the first and last positions unchanged. For every interior position, add one when its value is lower than both adjacent values, subtract one when it is higher than both, and otherwise leave it unchanged. Repeat complete daily updates until a day produces no change, then return that stable array.
constraints: Each day updates all interior values simultaneously until stable.
hints: Copy the current day before changing any interior position.
Raise strict valleys by one and lower strict peaks by one.
Repeat until a full day makes no change.
Copying enforces simultaneous updates; bounded neighbor gaps guarantee convergence.
editorial: Copying enforces simultaneous updates; bounded neighbor gaps guarantee convergence.

tests.explanation: Two rises to three on the first day, after which the array is stable.
Repeated simultaneous peak and valley changes eventually stabilize the interior.
